landing.title: Telegram Power Toolset
landing.subtitle: Advanced features for Telegram that aren't available in official apps. 100% on-device, open source, and privacy-focused.
landing.welcomeText: Click on any tool below to get started. You'll be prompted to connect your Telegram account.

backups.noActiveBackupsHint: Only archived local backups remain. They will recover automatically when the matching phone signs in again, or you can delete them here.
backups.legacyHint: This backup was created before account ownership existed. Claim it to keep it with the current account, or delete it if you no longer need it.
backups.archivedHint: Archived backups stay out of resend flows until the matching phone signs in again. Delete them only if you no longer need the local copy.
backups.quarantinedHint: These backups lost their link to an account and stay hidden until repaired. Assign one to the current account to restore it, or delete it.
backups.contentUnavailableHint: This backup's data was removed by the browser. Only the summary remains — delete it and export again from Telegram.

llmExport.title: LLM Context Export
llmExport.description: Export chat history formatted for AI assistants like Claude
llmExport.infoDescription: Chat history is cached locally. After downloading, you can experiment with different output formats instantly without re-downloading.
llmExport.noExportsHint: Download a chat to get started
llmExport.noActiveExports: No active exports for this account

llmExport.legacyHint: This export was cached before account ownership existed. Claim it to keep it with the current account, or delete it if you no longer need it.
llmExport.archivedHint: Archived exports stay out of the active list until the matching phone signs in again. Delete them only if you no longer need the local copy.
llmExport.quarantinedHint: These exports lost their link to an account and stay hidden until repaired. Assign one to the current account to restore it, or delete it.
llmExport.selectExportDesc: Choose a cached export from the list to configure its format
llmExport.customTemplateHint: Variables: sender, date, text, media, reply, forward — wrap in double curly braces, use #each messages / /each for loops
llmExport.useOriginalNamesHint: Use the person's Telegram display name instead of your contact name for them
llmExport.dateGroupingHint: Per-day saves tokens by showing date once per day
llmExport.noPreview: Configure an export to see preview
llmExport.previewNote: Showing first 15 messages. Full output will include all messages.

templateDescriptions.custom: Define your own template with variables like sender, text, date
